title: Your Karma & Reputation
description: How to read your karma balance and trust score, what affects them, and how to grow your standing in the community.
content:
# Your Karma & Reputation

Your karma balance and trust score are the two main signals of your standing in the community.

---

## Your Karma Balance

Visible on your profile and dashboard.

**What it represents:** Karma earned (by helping others) minus karma spent (by receiving help). A positive balance means you've given more than you've received.

**What affects it:** Completing requests earns karma. Having requests fulfilled by others spends it. The amount depends on request type and community multiplier.

**What it doesn't mean:** A low balance doesn't mean you're a bad member — you may have just needed more help lately.

---

## Your Trust Score

Reflects your standing in the community's social graph.

**How it's built:** Every completed request creates a trust connection. Trust grows through repeated interactions (depth) and wide reach (breadth).

**How it's used:** Visible on your profile, factors into feed visibility and request prioritization.

---

## Karma Decay

Both your karma and trust score decay over time when inactive. The decay rate is set by your community.

As long as you're participating, decay doesn't apply. If you take a break and come back, your score will have dropped — but it's fully recoverable.

---

## How to Grow

**Karma:** Help others regularly. Choose higher-multiplier request types. Be consistent.

**Trust:** Help the same people more than once (depth). Help many different people (breadth). Never accept requests you can't complete.

---

## Multiple Communities

Karma and trust are tracked separately in each community you belong to. Build reputation in each through participation there.
